cards.title: Parents: Don't Buy Grand Theft Auto VI for Your Child
cards.body: Rockstar Games' 18-rated game is stuffed with explicit sex, drugs, and violence—the most graphic content in any game. It's genuinely not appropriate for kids, no matter how much they beg.

cards.title: My Son's Back Home—Mothering Skills Gone
cards.body: A graduate son returning home after university forces parents to renegotiate household dynamics. The extended "holiday phase" has shifted into something longer and more complex.

cards.title: Parents Urged to Spot Online Stalking Warning Signs
cards.body: Cases of online stalking targeting young people are rising, with predators using fake profiles and unwanted contact. Specialists break down key warning signs parents should take seriously.

cards.title: Teen Gamer and Mother Help Rescue Missing Girl
cards.body: A 16-year-old Landon Tresp and his mother helped the FBI rescue a kidnapped girl after meeting her in an online game. Their quick action and cooperation with authorities prevented serious harm.

cards.title: The Holidays on a Tight Budget
cards.body: Economic strain can make holiday traditions harder for families to maintain. Experts recommend talking openly with kids about financial challenges while preserving what matters most.
